summary: Install-time fetch and execute from non-registry host via smuggled dependency
details: merchantweb-lang-cookie-reset@1.0.999 declares a dependency (packet-table-thread-stream) resolved from a hardcoded non-npm URL at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/packet-table-thread-stream, and the shrinkwrap marks that dependency hasInstallScript: true. On `npm install`, npm downloads the tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com — a host unrelated to the npm registry — and runs its lifecycle install scripts on the installer's machine. The package itself is otherwise near-empty (generic 'Generated package' metadata, example.com repository, anomalous 1.0.999 version), consistent with a lure whose only install-time effect is resolving to and executing code from the external host. The delivered tarball is not published to npm and its contents cannot be inspected from the registry copy.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
